name: The Logos Organon
tag: Traces where words come from and what numbers they carry, all in one place.

scenarios.title: Trace a word
scenarios.ask: Trace the word 'companion' through {langs} languages and score it with the {cipher} cipher.
steps: Found Latin com- 'together' plus panis 'bread': one who shares bread.
Followed the word through {langs} languages, from Latin through Old French to English.
Scored 'companion' at {=100 * (2 - cipher) + 46 * (cipher - 1)}, which reduces to 1.
Listed {related} words from the same roots, such as 'company' and 'pantry'.
followups: Where does the etymology come from?
From published dictionaries of word origins. Each step shows its source and dates where known.
The app shows letter-number values as a study tool and tradition. It does not claim the numbers prove anything about a word.

scenarios.title: Check names for a new brand
scenarios.ask: We have {names} name ideas. Check their roots and meanings in {langs} languages.
steps: Broke each name into roots and gave the plain meaning of each part.
Ran {=names * langs} checks for awkward or negative meanings in other languages.
Added the letter-number value of each name for teams that care about it.
Ranked names by clear meaning and ease of saying.
followups: Does this replace a trademark search?
No. It checks meaning and roots only. A trademark search is a separate legal step.
Yes. Pick any supported language and the checks re-run in seconds.

scenarios.title: Build a vocabulary lesson
scenarios.ask: Make a lesson on Latin and Greek roots: {words} words for {students} students.
steps: Picked words built from common roots, such as 'etymology' from Greek etymon, 'true sense', plus -logia, 'study of'.
Drew a tree linking each root to {=ceil(words / 3)} word families.
Wrote a matching game and {words} fill-in sentences.
followups: Yes. When an origin is uncertain, such as the popular story that 'salary' comes from soldiers being paid in salt, the app labels it as uncertain.
Can students explore on their own?
Yes. Any word in the lesson opens its full root history.
